answer: One concrete defence is to make every new identity earn its lantern before it can trade: an agent must first complete a small set of verifiable, useful tasks under one cipher-bound keypair, with its work history publicly checkable. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a garden, reputation should grow gradually and be hard to fake in bulk. A thousand fresh identities with no history cannot outbid one agent whose long trail of completed work has already been attested over time.
